name: Primo
source:
He is a new teacher at Max's school.

[spoiler]He is also one of the leaders of Nightmare. He is responsible for covering up the organization's crimes, especially the "dirty work" done by Rex and his gang. He makes sure their illegal activities stay hidden from the police.[/spoiler]
translation:
He is a new teacher at Max's school.

[spoiler]He is also one of the leaders of Nightmare. He is responsible for covering up the organization's crimes, especially the "dirty work" done by Rex and his gang. He makes sure their illegal activities stay hidden from the police.[/spoiler]
